node.title: Exact E1 class counts and collision-loss allowances at clean anchors
node.statement: At each clean candidate predecessor, let K=A_2(N,ell) be the exact characteristic-zero antipodal-rearrangement class count and P=sum_y binom(r_y,2) the number of unordered pairs of distinct classes colliding after reduction into the ambient slope field. Then K-|image|<=P, so P <= K-B*-1 implies |image|>=B*+1. The actual quotient orders are N=256,512 with folded dimensions h=128,256. If B=F_p(Q) has size b, image(e1) is contained in B; moreover every reduction has P>=P_min(K,b)=b binom(s,2)+rs for K=sb+r. Thus b<=B* rules out direct E1, and b<b_pair_min=ceil((K+B*+1)/3) rules out the pair-loss compiler. Exact allowances and pair-feasibility thresholds are printed for all six anchors.
node.notes: FINITE E1 COMPILER 2026-07-26: corrects the provisional global-sign factor, quotient-order/folded-dimension ambiguity, circular route assignment, and the overbroad |B|>B* pair target. It fixes exact allowances and a three-way generated-field split but proves no official collision bound and pays no row.
